description: Phase-32 RESEARCH-ONLY mechanism-discrimination vocab. Read ONLY by scripts/root_cause_discriminator.py (un-wired). Given a validity-passed candidate, the engine SCORES each enumerated mechanism by SOURCE-BACKED comparand evidence (present-elsewhere/absent-here on the SAME state var, a units/decimals requirement, or a self-computed-unapplied value) and REJECTS design-absence mechanisms with no comparand. Engine reads ONLY source snippets + the located bundle + call/callee context + these generic patterns; it NEVER sees award labels, issue IDs, contest text, or expected_mechanism.json. Patterns are GENERIC (standard DeFi vocab), not anchor-specific. is_gate:false research_only:true routes_in_production:false routed_manifest_ids:[].

missing_scale.comment: a sibling applies a scale op (scale_op_patterns) with a scale-named var (scale_token_patterns) around a transfer (transfer_patterns) that the target's same transfer omits -> STRONG

wrong_basis.comment: target passes a value of one basis where a sibling converts via an explicit conversion call -> STRONG; no distinct conversion comparand -> WEAK

omitted_term.comment: a term-named var (term_name_patterns) is assigned in the target but absent from the value arg of a transfer/state-change path -> MEDIUM

missing_call.comment: a call present in a sibling before a shared transfer is absent in the target before its shared transfer -> STRONG

recipient_missing.comment: alias of missing_call scoped to resolution_call_patterns

missing_bound.comment: the named bound (bound_name_patterns) must appear in a sibling/callee but be absent in the target to score; if absent EVERYWHERE it is a design-absence -> REJECT (constraint 6)

rounding_loss.comment: target does div-before-mul where a sibling does mul-before-div on the same operands -> STRONG; else WEAK
